evidence.sourceCondition: S. cerevisiae sporulation versus mitotic growth; RNA evidence reused from Chu et al. 1998 (GDS104/GSE27); Nocedal 2017 additionally selected genes required for sporulation using SGD.
evidence.authorPanel: 65 genes required for sporulation in S. cerevisiae that exhibit meiotic upregulation
evidence.directionContext: sporulation relative to mitotic growth; author figure caption and Methods; missing or dubious cases are held for review
